plainText:
Doug (Japanese: ダグ Doug) and Eva (Japanese: エバ Eva) are a father and daughter who live in an unnamed town in southern Galar. They are characters of the day who appeared in the episode Sword and Shield, Slumbering Weald!.

==In animation==
===History===
Eva was feeding her father's , nicknamed Centy, some Oran Berries, when it was suddenly hit by a beam of Dynamax energy that came all the way from the Energy Plant in Hammerlocke. This caused Centy to Gigantamax and go on a rampage throughout the town. Shortly afterwards, arrived at the town and met up with Doug and Eva. After talking to them, Ash promised to stop Centy and return it to normal. After failing to do so, stepped in and defeated Centy with his . The Radiator Pokémon subsequently returned to normal and reunited with Doug and Eva.
